title: GIG-3832: Flag PRs That Introduce Outbound Communications
description: Adds a forced-escalation category to the create-pr skill so pull requests that introduce or enable outbound communications are labelled risk:high.

test_plan.description: Synced create-pr skill includes the outbound communications rule
steps: Open templates/skills/create-pr/SKILL.md and confirm the Forced escalation section requires risk:high for new or newly enabled email, SMS, letters, scheduled or queued senders, and bulk mail
Confirm wording edits to an existing sender on the same trigger and audience stay on the normal risk scale
